description:
We have a new Joomla based ecommerce website that has been developed by another company. We need someone to come in and debug, q.a. and add a few more pages.  The site does have some JavaScript, some data collection for emails and a shopping cart (Amazon). 

 OTHER QUALIFICATIONS 
 Extensive working knowledge of: 
 HTML/XHTML 
 CSS 
 Joomla 
 JavaScript 
 ASP 
 Flash 
 Scripts 
 e-Commerce – specifically integration with Amazon Graphics 

 Plano, TX (3+ week contract)
